title: Checklist Step Most Often Missed
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=preflight:check completed=false
| stats count as misses by checklist_item
| sort - misses
description: Ranks the pre-flight checklist steps you skip or delay most often.
value: A recurring miss on the same item is exactly the pattern checklists exist to expose.
implementation: Send checklist outcomes to `index=personal`; review the most frequently incomplete items.
visualization: Top table of missed checklist items.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which pre-flight checklist steps you are most likely to skip or rush, so the weak spot becomes obvious.
